Draw one new relaxed right-facing SIDE VIEW standing pose: all four short paws supported at clearly separate depths, torso softly rounded, chest lifted, belly clearly off the invisible ground, neck relaxed, head level looking ahead. Tail up with a soft curved tip. Mouth closed with NO visible tongue. Not crouching or lying down. This will be the start and end of the drinking sequence. Feet near y=880; reproduce the reference's low, friendly cat proportions.
